contents.text: 恭喜你成功完成尋寶任務(2)！臺灣除了是行人地獄外，也有每年有數百萬動物死於車禍。根據路殺社的資料，2012年到2017年，記錄到98700起、550種野生動物路殺死亡，其中有8200起是保育類動物。讓我們繼續這場冒險探索臺大校園，為保護生態環境貢獻了一份力量，下一個任務等著你！

Congratulations on successfully completing Treasure Hunt Mission (2)! Besides being a pedestrian nightmare, Taiwan also sees millions of animals killed in traffic accidents each year. According to data from the Roadkill Society, between 2012 and 2017, there were 98,700 recorded roadkill incidents involving 550 species of wild animals, of which 8,200 involved protected species. Let’s continue this adventure exploring the NTU campus and contribute to protecting the ecological environment. The next mission is waiting for you!
